user.description: Choose a HoMedics Drift sand table. Tables advertise a Bluetooth name of at least 12 characters starting with KS. No pairing is required.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up the HoMedics Drift table {name}?

abort.already_configured: This Drift table is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: This Drift table is already being configured.
abort.no_devices_found: No HoMedics Drift tables were found. Plug the table in, bring a Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome proxy closer, and try again.
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a HoMedics Drift table.
abort.no_ai: No AI Task entities were found. Add an AI integration in Home Assistant, then open these options again.

init.title: AI drawing
init.description: Pick an AI Task from the list. Each row is the assistant's name and its entity id. Leave it empty to use Home Assistant's preferred AI Task, or the first one that is online. No API key is stored here.

upload_pattern.name: Upload pattern
upload_pattern.description: Store a Sandify .thr pattern on the table under a name.

device_id.name: Table
device_id.description: Drift table. Needed only when more than one table is set up.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name to show in the Pattern select.

path.name: File path
path.description: Path under the config folder, such as /config/drift_patterns/spiral.thr.

thr.name: Pattern text
thr.description: Theta-rho text, used when a file path is not given.

delete_pattern.name: Delete pattern
delete_pattern.description: Delete a pattern uploaded from Home Assistant. Stock patterns and the one that is drawing are refused.

device_id.name: Table
device_id.description: Drift table. Needed only when more than one table is set up.

rename_pattern.name: Rename pattern
rename_pattern.description: Remember a display name for a pattern id, including a stock id. The table is not changed.

device_id.name: Table
device_id.description: Drift table. Needed only when more than one table is set up.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name to show in the Pattern select.

ai_draw.name: Draw with AI
ai_draw.description: Ask the configured Home Assistant assistant for one sand drawing, then upload it. One model call. Nothing is played while Power is off.

device_id.name: Table
device_id.description: Drift table. Needed only when more than one table is set up.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.description: What to draw, in a few words.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name in the Pattern list. Defaults to the prompt.

play.name: Play
play.description: Start the drawing when Power is on.

generate_pattern.name: Generate pattern
generate_pattern.description: Upload a built-in spiral, rose, star, wave, or spirograph. No assistant is used.

device_id.name: Table
device_id.description: Drift table. Needed only when more than one table is set up.

type.name: Type
type.description: spiral, rose, star, wave, or spirograph.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name in the Pattern list. Defaults to the type.

play.name: Play
play.description: Start the drawing when Power is on.

inner.name: Inner radius
inner.description: Spirograph rolling radius. Must be smaller than the outer radius.

add_gallery_design.name: Add gallery design
add_gallery_design.description: Upload one of the built-in gallery designs by its name. Plays only while Power is on.

device_id.name: Table
device_id.description: Drift table. Needed only when more than one table is set up.

name.name: Name
name.description: Gallery name, such as Lotus Mandala or Nebula Spiral.

play.name: Play
play.description: Start the design when Power is on.

import_pattern_url.name: Import pattern link
import_pattern_url.description: Download a .thr file or a zip of .thr files from an https link and upload the ones that fit. Nothing is stored in this integration ahead of time.

device_id.name: Table
device_id.description: Drift table. Needed only when more than one table is set up.

url.name: Link
url.description: https link to a .thr file or a zip that contains .thr files.

set_favorite.name: Set favorite
set_favorite.description: Mark or unmark a design by name. Favorites show in the Favorites list.

device_id.name: Table
device_id.description: Drift table. Needed only when more than one table is set up.

favorite.name: Favorite
favorite.description: Turn the heart on or off.
